Role.title: Role
Role.description: Defines the different access levels and responsibilities for users within the SmartRest AI system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Role entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the role's permissions and responsibilities.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a staff member of the restaurant with an assigned role.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for login and identification.

roleId.description: Reference to the Role entity, indicating the user's assigned role. (Relationship: Role 1:N User)

isActive.description: Indicates whether the user account is currently active and can log in.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

Table.title: Table
Table.description: Represents a physical dining table within the restaurant.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Table entity.

tableNumber.description: A unique identifier or name for the table (e.g., 'T1', 'Bar_A').

capacity.description: The maximum number of guests this table can accommodate.

location.description: A description of the table's physical location (e.g., 'Main Dining Room', 'Patio', 'Window Seat').

status.description: The current status of the table (e.g., 'free', 'occupied', 'reserved').

lastOccupiedAt.description: Timestamp when the table was last marked as occupied.

MenuItemCategory.title: MenuItemCategory
MenuItemCategory.description: Organizes menu items into logical categories (e.g., Appetizers, Main Courses, Beverages).

id.description: Unique identifier for the MenuItemCategory entity.

name.description: The name of the menu category (e.g., 'Appetizers', 'Drinks').

description.description: A brief description of the category.

MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: Represents a single food or beverage item available on the restaurant's menu.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MenuItem entity.

name.description: The name of the menu item (e.g., 'Classic Burger', 'Caesar Salad').

description.description: A detailed description of the menu item, including ingredients or preparation.

price.description: The selling price of the menu item.

categoryId.description: Reference to the MenuItemCategory entity this item belongs to. (Relationship: MenuItemCategory 1:N MenuItem)

isAvailable.description: Indicates if the item is currently available for order.

imageUrl.description: Optional URL to an image of the menu item.

prepTimeMinutes.description: Estimated time in minutes required to prepare this item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the menu item was created or added.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the menu item was last updated.

Ingredient.title: Ingredient
Ingredient.description: Represents a raw material or stock item used in the preparation of menu items.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Ingredient entity.

name.description: The name of the ingredient (e.g., 'Tomatoes', 'Chicken Breast').

unitOfMeasure.description: The unit in which the ingredient is measured and tracked (e.g., 'kg', 'grams', 'pieces', 'liters').

currentStock.description: The current quantity of the ingredient available in inventory.

minStockLevel.description: The minimum stock level for this ingredient, below which an alert should be triggered.

supplierInfo.description: Optional information about the supplier of this ingredient.

costPerUnit.description: The cost of acquiring one unit of this ingredient.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the ingredient was first added to inventory tracking.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the ingredient's details or stock was last updated.

MenuItemIngredient.title: MenuItemIngredient
MenuItemIngredient.description: Links MenuItems to Ingredients, specifying the quantity of each ingredient needed for a particular menu item. This models a N:N relationship.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MenuItemIngredient linking entity.

menuItemId.description: Reference to the MenuItem entity. (Relationship: MenuItem N:N Ingredient)

ingredientId.description: Reference to the Ingredient entity. (Relationship: MenuItem N:N Ingredient)

quantityNeeded.description: The quantity of the ingredient required for one serving of the menu item, in the ingredient's unit of measure.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this ingredient requirement was defined.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this ingredient requirement was last updated.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer's order placed at a specific table, managed by a waiter.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

tableId.description: Reference to the Table entity where the order was placed. (Relationship: Table 1:N Order)

waiterId.description: Reference to the User entity (waiter) who took the order. (Relationship: User 1:N Order)

status.description: The current overall status of the order (e.g., 'pending', 'preparing', 'ready', 'served', 'cancelled', 'paid').

orderTime.description: Timestamp when the order was initially placed by the waiter.

preparationStartTime.description: Timestamp when the kitchen started preparing the order.

serveTime.description: Timestamp when the order was fully served to the customer.

totalAmount.description: The calculated total amount of the order, including all items and taxes.

customerNotes.description: Any special requests or notes provided by the customer for the entire order.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the order record was last updated.

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: Represents a single menu item within a specific order.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OrderItem entity.

orderId.description: Reference to the Order entity this item belongs to. (Relationship: Order 1:N OrderItem)

menuItemId.description: Reference to the MenuItem entity that was ordered. (Relationship: MenuItem 1:N OrderItem)

quantity.description: The quantity of this specific menu item ordered.

priceAtOrder.description: The price of the item at the moment the order was placed (to account for potential future price changes).

itemStatus.description: The specific status of this individual item within the order (e.g., 'pending', 'preparing', 'ready', 'served', 'cancelled').

notes.description: Any specific notes or modifications for this particular order item (e.g., 'no onions', 'extra cheese').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order item record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the order item record was last updated.

SalesTransaction.title: SalesTransaction
SalesTransaction.description: Records details of a completed payment transaction for an order, enabling financial reporting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SalesTransaction entity.

orderId.description: Reference to the Order entity that was paid. (Relationship: Order 1:1 SalesTransaction)

transactionTime.description: Timestamp when the payment transaction was completed.

amountPaid.description: The total amount of money received for this transaction.

cashierId.description: Reference to the User entity (cashier) who processed the payment. (Relationship: User 1:N SalesTransaction)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the sales transaction record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the sales transaction record was last updated.

InventoryTransaction.title: InventoryTransaction
InventoryTransaction.description: Tracks all movements (in and out) of ingredients in the inventory.

id.description: Unique identifier for the InventoryTransaction entity.

ingredientId.description: Reference to the Ingredient entity affected by this transaction. (Relationship: Ingredient 1:N InventoryTransaction)

quantityChange.description: The amount of ingredient added (positive) or removed (negative) in this transaction.

newStockLevel.description: The stock level of the ingredient after this transaction was applied.

recordedByUserId.description: Reference to the User entity who recorded this inventory transaction. (Relationship: User 1:N InventoryTransaction)

transactionTime.description: Timestamp when the inventory transaction occurred.

notes.description: Any additional notes or details regarding the transaction.

relatedOrderId.description: Optional reference to an Order entity if the stock-out is due to an order being prepared. (Relationship: Order 1:N InventoryTransaction)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the inventory transaction record was created.

definition.description: Defines the static roles available in the system (e.g., 'Admin', 'Cashier'). These are system-wide definitions, typically read-only for most users and managed by administrators.

Stores individual staff member profiles, including their primary role ID. Users can read their own profile; administrators can manage all user profiles. Includes the user's primary role ID for application logic.

definition.description: Dedicated collection for Waiter role authorization. A document with `id: {userId}` indicates the user is a Waiter. Used for atomic `exists()` checks in security rules for Waiter permissions.

params.description: The unique identifier of the user, corresponding to Firebase Authentication UID.

definition.description: Defines categories for menu items (e.g., 'Appetizers', 'Main Courses'). Primarily read-only for most users, managed by administrators.

params.name: categoryId

definition.description: Represents individual menu items offered by the restaurant. Includes pricing, availability, and category reference. Primarily read-only for most users, managed by administrators.

definition.description: Tracks raw ingredients for inventory management. Includes stock levels and supplier info. Read-only for Kitchen/Admin, writable by Admin.

params.name: ingredientId
params.description: The unique identifier for an ingredient.

definition.description: Links menu items to their required ingredients and quantities. This is a junction table for N:N relationships. Read-only for Kitchen/Admin, writable by Admin.

params.description: The unique identifier for a MenuItem-Ingredient linking record.

params.name: orderId

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for SmartRest AI prioritizes Authorization Independence and Query-Accurate Permissions (QAPs) by strategically denormalizing authorization-critical fields and employing structural segregation. This design ensures robust, debuggable security rules and efficient data access.

**Authorization Independence:**

1.  **Role-Based Access Control (DBAC):** To eliminate hierarchical authorization dependencies (`get()`) in security rules for role checks, we introduce dedicated top-level collections for each role: `/roles_admin/{userId}`, `/roles_cashier/{userId}`, `/roles_waiter/{userId}`, and `/roles_kitchen/{userId}`. A document in these collections simply signifies that the `userId` associated with the document ID possesses that role. Security rules can then use an atomic `exists(/roles_admin/$(request.auth.uid))` check to determine a user's role without needing to read their full user profile or other documents. This allows for atomic operations (e.g., creating an order and its items in a batch) where authorization can be verified independently for each document write.

2.  **Order and OrderItem Authorization:** Managing orders involves multiple roles (Waiter creates, Kitchen prepares, Cashier processes payment). To ensure `OrderItem` documents can be secured without needing to fetch their parent `Order` document, critical authorization context from the `Order` is denormalized into each `OrderItem`. Specifically, `orderId`, `waiterId`, `tableId`, and the overall `orderStatus` from the parent `Order` are copied into every `OrderItem`. This allows security rules for `orderItems` to evaluate access (e.g., a Kitchen user can update `itemStatus` if `orderStatus` is 'preparing' and they are in the `/roles_kitchen` collection) based solely on the `OrderItem` document's own data. Similarly, `cashierId` is denormalized into `SalesTransaction` and `recordedByUserId` into `InventoryTransaction` to allow direct authorization checks.

**Query-Accurate Permissions (QAPs):**

1.  **Structural Segregation for Public/Shared Data:** Collections like `/roles`, `/menuItemCategories`, `/menuItems`, `/tables` (for basic status), and `/ingredients` (for read by Kitchen) are designed with homogeneous security postures. All documents within these collections are broadly accessible (e.g., read-only for all authenticated staff or specific roles, writable only by Admins/relevant roles). This simplifies security rules as `list` operations inherently return only authorized data, preventing rules from acting as inefficient filters.

2.  **Denormalized Context for Role-Specific Lists:** For collections like `/orders` and `/orderItems`, where different roles need to see subsets of data (e.g., a Waiter only sees their own orders, Kitchen only sees orders in 'preparing' status), the denormalized `waiterId`, `tableId`, and `orderStatus` fields become crucial. When a user queries `/orders` or `/orderItems`, their query should include filters matching their authorization context (e.g., `where('waiterId', '==', request.auth.uid)`). Because these fields are part of each document, the security rules can efficiently verify that the query's filters align with the user's permissions, thus enabling secure and performant `list` operations without requiring additional database reads in the rules themselves. For example, a Kitchen user listing `orderItems` would query `where('orderStatus', '==', 'preparing')`, and the rule would confirm that the user has the 'kitchen' role via an `exists()` check, combined with validating the `orderStatus` field in the queried document.
